report.explanation: Order service memory retention is classified NORMAL_WARMUP: retained bytes rose only 10 bytes over 5 samples, stayed far below the 33,554,432-byte limit, and GC reclaimed 20 bytes (retained dropped 40 to 20). All 5 requests succeeded with zero errors and p95 latency ~1e-6 ms. No deployment facts exist. Current evidence shows no fault, so no bounded root-cause candidate is substantiated.
missing_evidence: Evidence of an actual incident symptom (errors, latency degradation, or memory approaching the retention limit) for the order service
Deployment records or change history that could link any observed behavior to a release
Sustained retention growth without GC reclamation across a longer window to test for a leak
